title: South Clubhouse Closed for Voting
summary: The South Clubhouse will close to outside use at 4:00 PM Monday, August 17 for election setup and remain closed through Tuesday, August 18. Ice, the hall, and activities will be unavailable until Wednesday morning.
_public_detail_text: LRC that follows Potluck: There is not potluck this month and there will not be LRC game that is usually played after either. Please see the link next month as to if there is going to be Potluck and LRC next month. Bocce Ball: Just a reminder that Bocce play is weather permitting and depends on also on the wetness of the courts. It will be determined on a weekly basis. Voting in the South Clubhouse: Due to the primary voting going to be going on in the south clubhouse with set up at 4:00pm on Mon. August 17th and Voting all day Tues. Aug. 18th the clubhouse will be closed to outside use. There will not be access to ice, the hall, or any activities until Wed. Morning for coffee. Please plan to get any ice before 4:00pm on Monday. Thank you for your cooperation in this matter. Fob Use at both clubhouses: Please be advised that you should always bring your fob with you if you are coming to one of the clubhouses. The North doors cannot be programmed to open without. You will need one to enter the clubhouse for any activities or to use the restrooms. The South can be programmed but with the stormy weather the program gets bumped off line with lightning. You would need to use your fob to enter one of the other doors. You will need to do this to enter the building until it can be put back online. Thank you for understanding. By following these suggestions you will be able to enter the buildings when you need too.
